verdict.rationale: Speechmatics says it does not log customer data by default and offers on-device, on-prem and self-hosted deployment, which keeps audio out of the vendor's hands. It also documents job deletion that removes all associated resources. Together these imply customer data is not retained for model training, but no evidence explicitly addresses training use. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out control, documentation of how the default no-logging applies to model improvement, and independent corroboration.
